standard.summary: SafeGuard 检测到 loss spike 时，自动将学习率乘以 lr_reduction_factor 降低，而非直接停止训练。
standard.effect: 开启后 spike 触发时不停训，尝试以更低学习率继续。适合无人值守训练，宁可慢下来也不中断。
standard.whenToUse: 希望训练全程无人值守且不因一次 spike 中断时开启。结合 lr_reduction_factor=0.5 调整降幅。
standard.avoidWhen: 若 loss 爆炸是真实崩溃（如数据错误），自动降 LR 也救不了，建议关闭让训练直接停止排查。

standard_en.summary: When SafeGuard detects a loss spike, it multiplies the learning rate by lr_reduction_factor to lower it rather than stopping training outright.
standard_en.effect: With this on, a spike does not stop the run; it tries to continue at a lower learning rate. Suited to unattended training, where slowing down beats being interrupted.
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn it on when you want training to run unattended throughout and not be interrupted by a single spike. Tune the size of the reduction with lr_reduction_factor=0.5.
standard_en.avoidWhen: If the loss explosion is a real collapse (bad data, say), lowering the LR automatically will not save it -- turn this off and let training stop so you can investigate.

advanced.principle: 触发 spike 后调用 optimizer.param_groups 遍历，将所有参数组 lr *= lr_reduction_factor。不影响优化器动量等状态。
advanced.tradeoffs: 多次触发导致 LR 呈指数衰减（连续 3 次 0.5 倍 → 降至原 LR × 0.125），可能影响后续收敛速度。

advanced_en.principle: After a spike triggers, it iterates optimizer.param_groups and multiplies every param group's lr by lr_reduction_factor. Optimizer momentum and other state are untouched.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Multiple triggers make LR decay exponentially (three consecutive 0.5x → LR × 0.125), which can slow later convergence.
